context: Two teens swap weekend mall-and-food plans
purpose: Teach: 焼肉/百貨店/デッキ/蛙/水槽/ソフトウエア/小道具/浜松

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ、土曜さ、駅前の百貨店で新しい焼肉屋がオープンしたの知ってる?
lines.en: Hey, did you hear a new yakiniku place opened in the department store by the station on Saturday?
lines.style: Excited teen girl sharing weekend gossip with friend

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: マジで?行きたい!でも俺、午前中は浜松から来るいとこを迎えに行かなきゃなんだよね。
lines.en: Seriously? I wanna go! But I gotta pick up my cousin coming from Hamamatsu in the morning.
lines.style: Casual teen boy responding with slight reluctance

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: じゃあ午後でいいよ。屋上のデッキにペット屋さんあるじゃん?あそこの水槽の魚見てから行かない?
lines.en: Then afternoon works. You know the pet shop on the rooftop deck? Wanna check out the fish tanks before we go?
lines.style: Cheerful planning suggestion from energetic teenager

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいね。前見たとき、変な蛙もいてさ、めっちゃ可愛かったんだよ。
lines.en: Sounds good. Last time I saw some weird frogs there too, they were super cute.
lines.style: Relaxed boy adding detail with mild enthusiasm

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 蛙かわいいよね!あ、そういえばいとこって何年生?一緒にご飯行っても大丈夫なタイプ?
lines.en: Frogs are so cute! Oh, by the way, what grade is your cousin in? The type who's okay joining us for dinner?
lines.style: Curious teen girl checking social vibe before plans

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 全然平気だよ。むしろゲーム好きで、新しいソフトウエア試したいから秋葉系の店も寄りたいって言ってた。
lines.en: Totally fine. Actually she's into games and said she wants to swing by the Akiba-style shops to try new software.
lines.style: Easygoing boy describing cousin's nerdy interests warmly

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あ、それなら百貨店の上の階にゲーム売り場あるし、文化祭で使う小道具も同じフロアで揃うよ。
lines.en: Oh, then there's a game section on the upper floor of the department store, and you can grab festival props on the same floor too.
lines.style: Helpful teen offering practical mall layout knowledge

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 助かる。じゃあ焼肉は夕方の六時くらいでどう?お小遣いギリギリだけど。
lines.en: Thanks, that helps. So yakiniku around six in the evening? My allowance is barely gonna cover it though.
lines.style: Boy laughing about tight teen budget concerns

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 了解!お腹空かせて待ってる。いとこちゃんとも仲良くなれそうで楽しみ。
lines.en: Got it! I'll come hungry. I'm looking forward to getting along with your cousin too.
lines.style: Warm girl wrapping up plans with genuine anticipation
